political_decisions = {
	reclaim_our_lands_angoche = {
		picture = noimage
		potential = {
			tag = AGC
			NOT = {
				has_country_flag = great_angoche
			}
		}
		allow = {
			war = no
			AGC = {
				all_core = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			
		}
		effect = {
			Prestige = 5
			add_country_modifier = {
				name = great_angoche
				duration = 3650
			}
			set_country_flag = great_angoche
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			factor = 0
		}
	}
	adoptar_tecnologias_occidentales = {
		picture = westernize_nation
		potential = {
			civilized = no
			ai = no
			NOT = {
				has_country_flag = western_techs
			}
		}
		allow = {
			OR = {
				civilization_progress = 0.5
				AND = {
					civilization_progress = 0.4
					literacy = 0.04
				}
			}
		}
		effect = {
			add_country_modifier = {
				name = western_techs
				duration = 1825
			}
			set_country_flag = western_techs
		}
	}
	expand_angoche = {
		picture = zanzibar_oman
		potential = {
			tag = AGC
			NOT = {
				has_country_flag = angoche_expanded
			}
		}
		allow = {
			war = no
			ZAN = {
				all_core = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			
		}
		effect = {
			Prestige = 15
			add_country_modifier = {
				name = african_pride
				duration = -1
			}
			ZAN = {
				all_core = {
					add_core = THIS
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = angoche_expanded
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			factor = 0
		}
	}
}
